functional_differences: TP2 source-change coefficient changes from +0.5 to -0.5
DV_eletric source-change coefficient changes from +0.5 to -0.5
matched: same paired seeds and evaluation windows
nonfunctional_difference: processor_state.origin text records candidate versus historical control provenance and is not read by transform
no_transform_leakage: Code reads only the past x supplied by the trusted trainer, writes x.clone(), and reads each source from original x. No target, file, network, trainable state or batch mixing is present in transform.
runtime_validation: Both processors passed CPU and CUDA checks on 17 real T windows, including state immutability and batch independence; these finite checks are not a universal proof.
control_appropriateness: Appropriate matched comparison for whether the two sign changes add value beyond the already known source-half representation under the fixed training procedure.
limitations: The sign changes alter input magnitude and covariance, so the comparison does not separate informational effects from optimization-scale effects.
The registered local scope includes H1, whose sign does not change against the control; the scope is preserved as preregistered.
The source mapping and half-mixing method are inherited historical knowledge. Success cannot be called source-half rediscovery.
The independent numeric T claim is a global Oil_temperature mean and establishes an arithmetic crosscheck only, not the correctness of the richer correlation interpretation.
Same-source reused development data and random-seed confirmation do not establish independent generalization or the causal value of feedback.
